title: mcdonalds awaw smp
description: mcdonalds mod for me and my friends
body:
This project introduces a fun and flavorful McDonald’s-themed expansion to Minecraft, adding new food items, a unique villager profession, and a custom workstation.

Features
McDonald’s Food Items
Craft or obtain a variety of McDonald’s-inspired meals such as burgers, fries, and drinks. These items offer new food options for players looking to add something fresh to their survival experience.

New Villager Profession
A special villager type has been added, dedicated to producing and trading McDonald’s-themed items. Players can interact with this villager to obtain exclusive foods or materials related to the new profession.

Custom Workstation
A new workstation block is included, used by the new villager profession and available for the player as a functional crafting station. This block is essential for preparing certain recipes and expanding your food options.
